question: Which of the following iron ore is mined at Bailadila?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hematite**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The **Bailadila** iron ore range is located in the **Dantewada** district of **Chhattisgarh**. It is one of the largest and richest iron ore deposits in the world.

• The primary type of iron ore mined at **Bailadila** is **Hematite**. This ore is of extremely high grade, containing approximately **60% to 70%** metallic iron content.

• The name **Bailadila** translates to **'Hump of an Ox'** in the local language, a name given because the mountain range resembles the physical structure of a bull's hump.
